$comment: Forge Agent's TrueForge agent definition, sent inline with every new session (POST /api/v1/sessions) and model switch (PATCH). Filled in at run time: model.name from the forgeAgent.model setting (or forgeAgent.fallbackModel), the editor MCP server name (one per VS Code window), and instructions from src/agent/instructions.ts. Print the full spec with: pnpm run agent:spec

deferredTools.$comment: forgeAgent.deferTools: the editor server is sent with preload false, so only these tools are in every request; TrueForge's list_tools, get_tool_info and call_tool reach the rest.
